body.x: BeyondMedicine (CEO Daehyun Kim) participated in CES 2026 Unveiled, held on January 4 (local time) in Las Vegas, the United States.
Founded in 2022, BeyondMedicine is an AI-based digital therapeutics company that develops software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) by combining clinical treatment needs with software technology.

The company was established by a CEO with a doctorate in dentistry, working alongside digital healthcare specialists to address chronic pain and treatment gaps experienced by patients with temporomandibular disorder (TMD). Based on this collaboration, BeyondMedicine developed Clickless DTx, a digital therapeutic solution specialized for TMD.

BeyondMedicine has previously validated its technological reliability and commercialization potential both domestically and overseas. At CES 2026 Unveiled, the company introduced Clickless DTx to the global stage for the first time and began verifying its business potential in overseas medical and healthcare markets.

In particular, BeyondMedicine used the event to highlight the clinical effectiveness of Clickless DTx, its medical device approval from Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS), and its AI-based personalized treatment technology.

Clickless DTx is the world’s first digital therapeutic for temporomandibular disorder (TMD). It is a software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) that provides personalized treatment programs based on patients’ facial movement data and electronic patient-reported outcome measures (ePROM). By integrating TMD assessment, exercise therapy, behavioral management, and treatment progress tracking into a single digital solution, the product addresses limitations of conventional treatment approaches.

A key strength of Clickless DTx is its AI-based facial-recognition motion-analysis technology and its automatic generation of personalized treatment content. The system analyzes facial and temporomandibular movement data to assess exercise accuracy and incorporates ePROM data on pain, stress, and functional limitations. Based on this combined analysis, it dynamically adjusts treatment difficulty and content for each individual, delivering a continuously optimized treatment experience as the patient’s condition changes.

body.x: BeyondMedicine conducted and completed confirmatory clinical trials for Clickless DTx in collaboration with Hallym University Sacred Heart Hospital and Dongtan Hospital in Korea. Based on these clinical results, the company obtained MFDS approval for the medical device. In addition, Clickless DTx received an Innovative Medical Device designation from the MFDS in 2024, officially recognizing its clinical effectiveness and technological innovation. Building on this foundation, BeyondMedicine is advancing domestic commercialization while pursuing global regulatory approvals and market entry.

Overseas, the company was selected for the incubation program of U.S. healthcare accelerator Matter Health and is conducting local clinical and commercialization validation through the BIG (Big Idea Generator) program at the University of Illinois. BeyondMedicine is also working with the CareQuest Institute in the United States to carry out product validation testing for Clickless DTx, assessing its potential entry into the U.S. dental and healthcare markets.

At the same time, BeyondMedicine completed the FDA pre-submission process to secure U.S. regulatory approval. The company plans to begin with the U.S. market and subsequently expand Clickless DTx into Japan and Europe. In parallel, BeyondMedicine aims to broaden its business scope beyond TMD into oral and maxillofacial rehabilitation by expanding indications and functionalities, positioning itself for growth as a global digital healthcare company.

Meanwhile, the company will also participate in the leading CES 2026 exhibition, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-dedicated exhibition zone. The CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion, led by the Seoul Business Agency (SBA), brings together 19 startup support organizations in Seoul, including district offices, related institutions, and universities, to support 70 startups. The participating companies span advanced technology fields such as AI, mobility, and healthcare, and selected outstanding firms receive opportunities to participate in the official CES media event, CES Unveiled.

‘CES Unveiled’ is a key official event held ahead of the CES opening, bringing together Innovation Award winners and companies showcasing innovative, cutting-edge products. The event brings together global media, company executives, government officials, and significant technology industry stakeholders in one place.
